description: This file contains inline assembly functions for basic arithmetic operations optimized for ARMv5 architecture, used in AMR-WB speech codec decoding.

methods.name: sub_int16
methods.description: Performs 16-bit subtraction with inline assembly optimization.

methods.name: add_int16
methods.description: Performs 16-bit addition with inline assembly optimization.

methods.name: mul_32by16
methods.description: Multiplies 16-bit high and low parts with a 16-bit multiplier, optimized for ARMv5.

methods.name: msu_16by16_from_int32
methods.description: Multiply-Subtract operation on 16-bit inputs from a 32-bit accumulator.

methods.name: mac_16by16_to_int32
methods.description: Multiply-Accumulate operation on 16-bit inputs with a 32-bit accumulator.

methods.name: mul_16by16_to_int32
methods.description: Multiply two 16-bit integers resulting in a 32-bit value.

methods.name: mult_int16
methods.description: Multiply two 16-bit integers with result as 16-bit.

methods.name: amr_wb_round
methods.description: Rounds a 32-bit value to 16-bit with specific shifting.

methods.name: amr_wb_shl1_round
methods.description: Shifts and rounds a 32-bit value to 16-bit.
